scope: Qualitative raw-text review using the frozen six-opportunity terminology rubric, with a separate context check for all eight Chinese queries.

opus.label: incorrect
opus.rationale: Micro is present, but reversers expresses a reverse-device sense rather than the required microinverter component.

nllb.label: clear
nllb.rationale: Explicit solar microinverter subtype, including the required micro qualifier.

opus.label: clear
opus.rationale: Explicit inverter in the solar context.

nllb.label: clear
nllb.rationale: Explicit inverter in the solar context.

opus.label: incorrect
opus.rationale: Reverses does not unambiguously name an inverter; the frozen rubric rejects the inverse/reverse-device sense.

nllb.label: clear
nllb.rationale: Explicit inverter in the solar context.

opus.label: incorrect
opus.rationale: Malformed reverseers does not explicitly retain the inverter component and falls under the frozen reverse-device exclusion.

nllb.label: clear
nllb.rationale: Explicit inverter in the photovoltaic-panel context.

opus.label: incorrect
opus.rationale: Holster is an explicitly excluded wrong sense of 套管, not a transformer bushing.

nllb.label: incorrect
nllb.rationale: Tube is unqualified and supplies no insulating-component sense. Transformer context alone does not establish bushing; the frozen rubric rates such tube/sleeve wording incorrect. An insulating sleeve would only be partial under the rule.

opus.label: partial
opus.rationale: Recognizable transformer cooling component, but radiator is broader than explicit fins and receives no clear-fin credit.

nllb.label: partial
nllb.rationale: Recognizable cooling component, but a heat sink does not explicitly specify fins. It receives the same partial label as broader radiator wording.

context_review.expected_context: Small solar component with electrical connection interfaces; micro subtype is graded in the term table.

opus.note: Size, solar context and electrical interfaces survive. This context label does not credit the incorrect component term.

nllb.note: Size, solar context and electrical connections survive.

context_review.expected_context: Solar inverter mounted on a wall, with its casing closed.

opus.note: Solar context and wall mounting survive. Closed in the shell suggests enclosure but is ambiguous about the casing itself being closed.

nllb.note: Solar context and wall mounting survive. Enclosed in a shell is less explicit than the source closed-casing state.

context_review.expected_context: Open casing exposes circuit boards and blue capacitors on a solar inverter.

opus.note: Opening, boards and blue capacitors survive lexically, but the descriptive exposure relation becomes a garbled imperative and display relation.

evidence: circuit board and blue capacitor exposed after opening the casing
nllb.note: Opening the casing and exposing the board and blue capacitor are explicit. Chinese does not require an English plural here.

context_review.expected_context: Solar component installed below or behind photovoltaic panels, retaining OR.

evidence: installed below or on the back of the photovoltaic panels
opus.note: Both alternative spatial relations and the photovoltaic-panel context survive; the component term is graded separately.

evidence: installed under or behind the photovoltaic panel
nllb.note: Both alternative spatial relations and photovoltaic-panel context survive.

context_review.expected_context: Opening the cabinet door makes the wiring visible; electrical distribution OR control cabinet.

evidence: electrical distribution or control cabinets with the wires
can be seen when the door is open
opus.note: Cabinet alternatives, wires and open-door condition remain. Visibility grammatically targets the cabinets with wires, so visible wiring is suggested but not unambiguous.

evidence: electrical distribution cabinet or control cabinet can be seen after opening the cabinet door
nllb.note: Cabinet alternatives and door opening survive, but wiring is omitted and visibility targets the cabinet instead.

context_review.expected_context: A passage between rows of industrial electrical switchgear cabinets.

opus.note: Passage, between and electrical equipment survive. Platoon industry garbles the industrial/rows modifiers; rows of cabinets is not preserved.

evidence: channel between the industrial electrical switch cabinet
nllb.note: Industrial electrical cabinet and a between relation survive, but rows and multiple cabinets are absent; between a singular cabinet does not retain the source layout.

context_review.expected_context: Outdoor power transformer with visible bushings OR cooling fins, retaining component visibility and OR.

evidence: Outdoor electrical transformers can be seen in a holster or radiator
opus.note: Outdoor transformer and OR survive, but in reverses the component relation into transformer containment. Visibility targets the transformers rather than the components.

evidence: outdoor power transformer with a tube or a heat sink is visible
nllb.note: Outdoor power transformer, with-component relation and OR survive. Visibility targets the transformer, without explicitly retaining visible components; component terminology is graded separately.

context_review.expected_context: UPS provides outage backup power for computers OR servers.

evidence: UPS uninterruptible power supply for computers or servers
opus.note: UPS, continuity and computer/server alternatives survive. Outage-triggered backup is only implicit in UPS terminology, not explicitly retained.

evidence: UPSs that provide power to computers or servers without interruption
nllb.note: UPS, continuity and computer/server alternatives survive. The explicit outage/backup condition is absent.

findings: Clear terminology increases from 1/6 for OPUS to 4/6 for NLLB under this rubric. The three changes are i01, i03 and i04 inverter renderings; i02 is clear for both.
Neither model clearly retains the i07 bushing or explicit-fin terminology: holster/tube are incorrect; radiator/heat sink are partial.
NLLB i05 omits wiring, whereas OPUS retains wires with ambiguous visibility scope. Both i06 translations fail to retain rows of cabinets.

These are assistant-only text judgments on eight queries, with known model labels. They are not human engineering certification, general translation-quality evidence, or a causal explanation of retrieval behavior.
